_source: Captured from llama-server build b10731 on pw-bonus, 2026-09-03, serving qwen3.8-27b (GGUF, ctx 131072). These are verbatim recordings, not invented shapes: every field below was observed. Re-record against a new build rather than editing by hand.

models._note: Ollama-shaped, NOT OpenAI's {"object":"list","data":[...]}. A uniform /v1/models parser breaks here.

stream_usage_frame._note: Final frame carries usage with choices EMPTY. cached_tokens exposes prefix-cache reuse, which is how the unique-preamble defeat can be verified rather than trusted.

refusal_over_context._note: error.type is STRUCTURED and machine-readable. Definitive refusal evidence — no confirmation probe needed. n_prompt_tokens/n_ctx are exact.

error.message: request (144052 tokens) exceeds the available context size (131072 tokens), try increasing it

unknown_model_is_NOT_an_error._note: THE TRAP. An unknown model name returns 200 and serves the loaded model anyway, with empty content and finish_reason=length. That trips REASONING_ONLY and ABRUPT, so a harness bug reads as model degradation. The runner MUST send the real served_model_name.
